trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=0]
    if not pts: return out
    a=min(r for r,c in pts); b=max(r for r,c in pts)
    l=min(c for r,c in pts); t=max(c for r,c in pts)
    horizontal=sum(grid[r][c]!=0 for r in (a,b) for c in range(l,t+1))/(2*(t-l+1))
    vertical=sum(grid[r][c]!=0 for c in (l,t) for r in range(a,b+1))/(2*(b-a+1))
    if horizontal>=vertical:
        out[0]=[3]*w
    else:
        for row in out: row[-1]=3
    return out
